observations.source_state_note: Connected Opera accessibility tree showed NOWY JOGGER expression TCe 110 5-miejsc, biel alpejska, 84,050 PLN, 16-inch steel wheels and black fabric upholstery with denim inserts. Seven colour choices were directly visible. The current official Jogger price-list matrix confirms 5-seat Expression TCe 110 manual at 84,050 PLN.

note: Two previously unresolved CAT-GAP-002 exact colour surfaces were captured from exact current official Polish Dacia configurator states already open in the connected browser. Seven visible colour choices were recorded for each state. Per-colour surcharges were not exposed in the accessibility tree and are intentionally null. No colour compatibility was projected to another configuration.
